name: The Anchor in 3D
body: Ability 3. `mechanics-design.md` leaves the 3D form open: physics rope, a set swing arc or another traversal. Not started until Dean chooses.

comments.text: Filed 2026-11-16 before any code, from Dean's request to start using the Crimson and Thorn mechanics.

questions.text: Which form should the Anchor take in 3D: a set swing arc between two anchor points, a physics rope, or a grapple that pulls the player to the point?
questions.recommendation: A: a set swing arc between two anchor points. It is deterministic, easy to author in the editor and easy to read in a tutorial; a physics rope can come later.
